LESSON: MULTIPLICATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.5: Multiplication
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Multiplication, part of Numbers in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How can you work out multiplication using repeated addition? 2. How do model multiplication as repeated addition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Multiplication together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: Learners develop self- discipline as they work collaboratively in pairs or groups to model multiplication as repeated

addition of numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 by 4 and 5 using counters.

● Digital literacy: Interacting with digital technology as the learner plays adapted digital games involving multiplication

Values

Respect: As learners display humility as they take turns to practise multiplication of single digit numbers by 10 using multiplication

tables.
